title: Careers
intro: We hire occasionally, mostly in Ankara, and we are always interested in hearing from people who have been through this process themselves.

children.text: Counsellors who have studied abroad themselves and remember what it felt like to arrive somewhere with no language and no network. That experience is not a nice-to-have in this work, it is the job.
We also look for people who are comfortable telling an applicant that a route will not work for them. Anyone who finds that conversation difficult will not last here.
